sys_properties.description: Used for Driftwood Application - Expected differences that Driftwood’s Drift Report should ignore when comparing instances. - Comma-separated list of category|item_key pairs, for example applications|x_1327441_config_0,system_properties|glide.email.test.user. - Categories: plugins, applications, mid_servers, system_properties, clone_preservers, clone_exclusions. - Matching items are counted as “Ignored (expected)” instead of drift. - These entries are added to the built-in defaults (system_properties|glide.servlet.uri and the app’s own scope). - Read on every comparison; keep ignore_cache = true.
sys_properties.name: x_2160899_driftw_0.compare_ignore
